result.instructions: Tools for CentralStationCRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are still open and what are they worth in total?"; "Find the contact with the email anna@example.com and show her open tasks."; "Create a deal 'Website relaunch' for the company Muster GmbH worth 4,500 EUR.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CentralStationCRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run centralstationcrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run centralstationcrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run centralstationcrm_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. centralstationcrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The CentralStationCRM user this API key belongs to: id, name, login email, the account (subdomain) it is signed in to, timezone. Use the user id to assign records or tasks. GET /user.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the CentralStationCRM account (id, name, email). Use the ids for responsible-user filters and for assigning records. GET /users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List contact people. Optionally filter by tag and order by name, creation or last update. Use search_people to find a person by name, email or phone. GET /people.

order.description: Ordering (abc = by name, new = creation date, update = last change).

includes.description: Related records to embed (an extra call is not needed for them).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_search_people
tools.title: Search people
tools.description: Find people by last name, first name, email address or phone number (email and phone cannot be combined). Give at least one criterion. GET /people/search.

includes.description: Related records to embed (an extra call is not needed for them).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact person (last name required), optionally with email addresses and phone numbers. Nothing is sent to the contact. POST /people.

country_code.description: Language of the person as a 2-letter ISO 639-1 code, e.g. de or en (the vendor field is called country_code).

user_id.description: Responsible user id (default: the API user).

tools.name: centralstationcrm_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a person. Only the fields you give are sent; the rest stays. PUT /people/{id}.

country_code.description: New language of the person as a 2-letter ISO 639-1 code, e.g. de or en (the vendor field is called country_code).

background.description: New background notes (replaces the old text).

tools.name: centralstationcrm_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: WRITE: create a company. Nothing is sent to the contact. POST /companies.

user_id.description: Responsible user id (default: the API user).

tools.name: centralstationcrm_update_company
tools.title: Update company
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a company. Only the fields you give are sent. PUT /companies/{id}.

background.description: New background notes (replaces the old text).

tools.name: centralstationcrm_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal (sales opportunity). Use list_deal_types for pipeline and stage ids. Pipelines with a monetary value or target date need value and target_date (value_type defaults to total); the vendor says what is missing. Nothing is sent to the contact. POST /deals.

value.description: Monetary value (with value_type total: the full amount).

value_type.description: How the value is billed (default total).

target_date.description: Date the deal shall be won.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_update_deal
tools.title: Update deal
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a deal, for example move it to another stage or set its state to won or lost. Only the fields you give are sent. PUT /deals/{id}.

current_state.description: New state: open_0/25/50/75, won or lost.

value.description: Monetary value (with value_type total: the full amount).

value_type.description: How the value is billed (default total).

target_date.description: Date the deal shall be won.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (to-do, call, email, visit...) optionally attached to a person, company or deal and assigned to a user. Nothing is sent to the contact. POST /tasks.

fuzzy.description: true = only the day of precise_time matters, not the hour.

user_id.description: User the task is assigned to (default: the user behind the API key).

attachable_type.description: Kind of record the task belongs to (omit for a general task).

attachable_id.description: Id of that record (required with attachable_type).

tools.name: centralstationcrm_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task, for example mark it done (finished = true), rename it or reschedule it. Only the fields you give are sent. PUT /tasks/{id}.

fuzzy.description: true = only the day of precise_time matters.

tools.name: centralstationcrm_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to the history of one or more people, companies, deals or projects. Nothing is sent to the contact. POST /protocols.

confidential.description: true = visible only to users with at least power-user rights (not only to you).
